dependency_traceability.evidence: packages/runner/src/host/host-bridge.ts:28-49 constructor accepts options.requester; invoked at lines 64-68 (forwardToolCall) and lines 92-96 (requestInteraction). Zero hollow/decorative dependencies.

runtime_completeness.evidence: packages/protocol/test/host-methods.test.ts and packages/runner/test/host-bridge.test.ts import only new component files and stdio-server transport; zero legacy host-rpc imports. Legacy deletion deferred to full Task 2 per plan.

entrypoint_wiring.evidence: Task 2A is explicitly restricted to five exclusive component files without composition/Harness/export wiring to avoid concurrency collisions with Slice 0. Production wiring is a scheduled downstream gate.

anti_gaming.evidence: Strict line budgets respected (core: 33 LOC, protocol: 54 LOC, runner: 100 LOC). No business logic or error handlers truncated. Real JSON schemas with recursive finite checks and dynamic wire-ID correlation tests.

finding_1_kind_override.evidence: packages/runner/src/host/host-bridge.ts:85-90 extracts only declared title/message/data fields and binds explicit kind; verified by test in packages/runner/test/host-bridge.test.ts:262-286 and red log in fix-round-1-kind-override-red.log

finding_2_behavioral_red_evidence.evidence: Truthful behavioral RED->GREEN redo executed with valid unimplemented stubs: redo-host-methods-behavioral-red.junit.xml (7/13 failed, 0 module errors) and redo-host-bridge-behavioral-red.junit.xml (22/23 failed, 0 module errors); clean green runs verified.

findings.title: Direct propagation of raw ZodError on malformed host responses
findings.evidence: hostToolResultSchema.parse(rawResult) and jsonValueSchema.parse(rawResult) throw raw ZodError rather than a wrapped domain host error
findings.impact: Callers receive standard Zod validation error rather than a typed HostRpcProtocolError; sufficient for component boundary but should be normalized during runner composition

findings.title: Recursive lazy schema evaluation for deep JSON structures
findings.impact: Slight validation latency for deeply nested data structures; fully correct and acceptable for expected tool payloads

architecture_rules.residual_risk: Public package exports, runner assembleDurableZero composition, tools/register dynamic registration, and full model E2E execution remain pending downstream gates.
